entries.title: Oil Tycoon and GOP Donor Harold Hamm Asked Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt for Senate Appointment
entries.summary: Hamm is one of the wealthiest people in America and a Trump ally. He also called the White House about the job.
entries.content:
Oil and gas magnate Harold Hamm, one of the wealthiest people in America and a major Republican donor, called Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt on Thursday night, asking for the appointment to Oklahoma’s newly open Senate seat.

Additionally, Hamm called the White House to express interest in the job as well, according to two sources.

The governor is mulling multiple options, but according to three sources familiar with the matter, Hamm called Stitt to express his interest in the seat.
entries.author: Reese Gorman, Em Luetkemeyer
